name: Phantump

name: Steenee

name: Golisopod

name: Tapu Bulu

attacks.name: Stuck-In Tackle

name: Arcanine

name: Talonflame

name: Salandit

When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the
surroundings with flashes of light and sound.

The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath

name: Mareanie

name: Toucannon

name: Yungoos

name: Gumshoos

name: Stufful

name: Electrode

The more energy it charges up, the faster
it gets. But this also makes it more likely
to explode.

name: Ralts
description:
The horns on its head provide a strong power
that enables it to sense people's emotions.

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Kirlia
description:
It has a psychic power that enables it to distort
the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir
description:
To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic
power to create a small black hole.

abilities.name: Psy Shadow
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to the {P} Pokémon in the Active Spot.

name: Ekans
description:
By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger
than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok
description:
The latest research has determined that there
are over 20 possible arrangements of the
patterns on its stomach.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Farfetch'd
description:
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves
as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire
situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

attacks.name: Inferno Dance
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. Take an amount of {R} Energy from your Energy Zone equal to the number of heads and attach it to your Benched {R} Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thundering Hurricane
attacks.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Energized Blade
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Eevee Bag
effect:
Choose 1:

During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon that evolve from Eevee do +10 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon that evolves from Eevee.

name: Petilil
description:
The leaves on its head grow right back even if
they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those
who eat them.

name: Lilligant
description:
The fragrance of the garland on its head has
a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very
difficult.

name: Rowlet
description:
It sends its feathers, which are as sharp
as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong,
so its kicks are also formidable.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

name: Dartrix
description:
This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you
don't groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Decidueye
description:
It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at
opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss,
it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

attacks.name: Sniping Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Big Beat
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Big Beat.

name: Pheromosa
description:
A life-form that lives in another world, its body
is thin and supple, but it also possesses
great power.

attacks.name: Jump Blues
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Kartana
description:
This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin
as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Blacephalon
description:
It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the
explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

attacks.name: Beat Punk
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself.

name: Mantine
description:
If it builds up enough speed swimming, it
can jump out above the waves and glide
for over 300 feet.

name: Carvanha
description:
It won't attack while it's alone—not even if it
spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to
join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

name: Sharpedo
description:
As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo
will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling
toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Shinx
description:
The extension and contraction of its muscles
generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Luxio
description:
Strong electricity courses through the tips of
its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting
in foes.

name: Luxray
description:
It can see clearly through walls to track down its
prey and seek its lost young.

abilities.name: Intimidating Fang
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do −20 damage.

name: Blitzle
description:
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear.
It can catch lightning with its mane and store
the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
description:
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it
shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Emolga
description:
As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles
with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can
cause a lot of trouble.

attacks.name: Plasma Hurricane
attacks.effect: Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

name: Xurkitree
description:
Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently
a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

attacks.name: Electronica
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Zeraora
description:
It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents
apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack,
they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

abilities.name: Thunderclap Flash
abilities.effect: At the end of your first turn, take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

name: Clefairy
description:
It is said that happiness will come to those who
see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a
full moon.

name: Clefable
description:
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will
run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Phantump
description:
With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to
lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost
among the trees.

name: Trevenant
description:
People fear it due to a belief that it devours any
who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the
Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

name: Morelull
description:
It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone
seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Shiinotic
description:
Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to
sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing,
it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may put a random Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

name: Meditite
description:
It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens
its inner strength through meditation.

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

name: Medicham
description:
Through yoga training, it gained the psychic
power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Baltoy
description:
It moves while spinning around on its single foot.
Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on
their heads.

name: Claydol
description:
This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient
clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

abilities.name: Heal Block
abilities.effect: Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) can't be healed.

name: Rockruff
description:
This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young.
Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures,
but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

attacks.name: Lycanfang
attacks.effect: Discard a {F} Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Passimian
description:
This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries.
It won't obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls
without skill.

attacks.name: Let's Throw
attacks.effect: If Passimian is on your Bench, this attack does 40 more damage.

name: Sandygast
description:
If it loses its shovel, it will stick something
else—like a branch—in its head to make
do until it finds another shovel.

name: Palossand
description:
The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon
into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped,
it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Alolan Meowth
description:
It's accustomed to luxury because it
used to live with Alolan royalty. As a
result, it's very picky about food.

attacks.name: Meddle
attacks.effect: Discard a random Pokémon Tool card from your opponent's hand.

name: Alolan Persian
description:
The round face of Alolan Persian is considered
to be a symbol of prosperity in the Alola region,
so these Pokémon are very well cared for.

attacks.name: Fake Out
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Sandile
description:
It submerges itself in sand and moves as if
swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies
from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok
description:
Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see
even in the dead of night. They live in groups of
a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
description:
After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it
twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

attacks.name: Poaching Fangs
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, a card is chosen at random from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

name: Nihilego
description:
A life-form from another world, it was dubbed
a UB and is thought to produce a
strong neurotoxin.

abilities.name: More Poison
abilities.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon takes +10 damage from being Poisoned.

attacks.name: New Wave
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Grindcore
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Poipole
description:
This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be
chosen as a first partner in its own world.

attacks.name: 2-Step
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

name: Naganadel
description:
It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid
inside its body. It is one of the organisms known
as UBs.

attacks.name: Electro House
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Alolan Diglett
description:
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's habitat
caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

attacks.name: Happened to Headbutt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Triplet Headbutt
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

name: Aron
description:
It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks—
to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
description:
It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory
by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Aggron
description:
Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate
thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by
ramming into them horn first.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

name: Ferroseed
description:
It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging
to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

name: Ferrothorn
description:
This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks,
and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb
the nutrients it finds within the stone.

abilities.name: Steel Spikes
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

name: Stakataka
description:
It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one
appears to be made up of many life-forms
stacked one on top of each other.

attacks.name: Brass Rock
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

name: Lillipup
description:
This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious.
It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect
information about its surroundings.

name: Herdier
description:
Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon.
So much so that there's a theory that Herdier was
the first Pokémon to partner with people.

name: Stoutland
description:
These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans.
Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up
to people in about three days.

abilities.name: Guard Dog Visage
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon cost 1 {C} more.

name: Stufful
description:
Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out
to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
description:
Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show
its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is
dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

attacks.name: Superpowered Hug
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out.

name: Oranguru
description:
It normally spends its time meditating in the
treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other
Pokémon orders as it pleases.

name: Type: Null
description:
A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific
mission, it went berserk during an experiment,
so it was cryogenically frozen.

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

name: Silvally
description:
This is its form once it has awakened and
evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is
greatly increased.

attacks.name: Brave Buddies
attacks.effect: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 50 more damage.

name: Celesteela
description:
One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings
can be detected coming from both of its
huge arms.

abilities.name: Ultra Thrusters
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may switch your Active Ultra Beast with 1 of your Benched Ultra Beasts.

attacks.name: Moombahton
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

effect:
You can use this card only if your opponent hasn't gotten any points.

During your opponent's next turn, all of your Ultra Beasts take −20 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

effect: Switch out your opponent's Active Basic Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

name: Electrical Cord
effect: If the {L} Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, move 2 {L} Energy from that Pokémon and attach 1 Energy each to 2 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Beastite
effect: Attacks used by the Ultra Beast this card is attached to do +10 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon for each point you have gotten.

name: Gladion
effect: Put 1 random Type: Null or Silvally from your deck into your hand.

name: Looker
effect: Your opponent reveals all of the Supporter cards in their deck.

effect:

attacks.name: Big Beat
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Big Beat.

name: Growlithe
description:
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly
stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
description:
An ancient picture scroll shows that people
were captivated by its movement as it ran
through prairies.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

name: Froakie
description:
It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back.
The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise
take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
description:
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise
control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja
description:
It creates throwing stars out of compressed water.
When it spins them and throws them at high speed,
these stars can split metal in two.

abilities.name: Water Shuriken
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may do 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Jynx
description:
Its strange cries sound like human language.
There are some musicians who compose songs
for Jynx to sing.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Pidgey
description:
A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps
its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
description:
The claws on its feet are well developed.
It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute
to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
description:
When hunting, it skims the surface of water
at high speed to pick off unwary prey such
as Magikarp.

abilities.name: Drive Off
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

name: Aerodactyl
description:
This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times.
Apparently even modern technology is incapable
of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

attacks.name: Primal Wingbeat
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon into their deck.

attacks.name: Powerful Bloom
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Inferno Onrush
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Primeval Law
abilities.effect: Your opponent can't play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Scattering Cyclone
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Nihilego
description:
A life-form from another world, it was dubbed
a UB and is thought to produce a
strong neurotoxin.

abilities.name: More Poison
abilities.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon takes +10 damage from being Poisoned.

attacks.name: New Wave
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Ledyba
description:
These very cowardly Pokémon join together and
use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
description:
It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly
dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to
you, good things will happen to you.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Shuckle
description:
The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually
become a thick, pulpy juice.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

name: Roselia
description:
It uses the different poisons in each hand
separately when it attacks. The stronger its
aroma, the healthier it is.

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

name: Roserade
description:
The poison in its right hand is quick acting.
The poison in its left hand is slow acting.
Both are life threatening.

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Cacnea
description:
It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom
once a year.

name: Cacturne
description:
It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night
when it hunts for prey exhausted from the
desert's heat.

attacks.name: Spike Rend
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Chespin
description:
Eating lots of berries makes the bark shell that
covers Chespin's head and body grow sturdier.

name: Quilladin
description:
It can send a trailer flying with a tackle. It's numb
to pain, so even violent collisions don't faze it.

name: Chesnaught
description:
Its gentle disposition would have it avoid
conflict, but it gives opponents a thrashing with
its thorned fists when the situation calls for it.

attacks.name: Needle Lariat
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack, do 80 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

name: Scatterbug
description:
This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder
to repel enemies. It will eat different plants
depending on where it lives.

name: Spewpa
description:
Spewpa doesn't live in a fixed location. It roams
where it pleases across the fields and mountains,
building up the energy it needs to evolve.

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.effect: Put a random card that evolves from Spewpa from your deck into your hand.

name: Vivillon
description:
This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers
bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

attacks.name: Vivid Powder
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Asleep.

name: Buzzwole
description:
Buzzwole goes around showing off its
abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind
of Ultra Beast.

attacks.name: Ground Beat
attacks.effect: If your opponent has gotten exactly 1 points, this attack does 40 more damage.

name: Gossifleur
description:
It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous
song. This delightful display has charmed many
into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
description:
The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be
spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar
regional specialty.

attacks.name: Float Up
attacks.effect: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

abilities.name: Soothing Wind
abilities.effect: Each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

attacks.name: Energized Leaves
attacks.effect: If the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokémon is 5 or more, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Alolan Marowak
description:
The cursed flames that light up the bone carried
by this Pokémon are said to cause both mental
and physical pain that will never fade.

attacks.name: Fiery Bone
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

name: Reshiram
description:
When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves
the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

attacks.name: Blue Flare
attacks.effect: Discard 2 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Litleo
description:
The more a Litleo trains its body and spirit by
battling mighty enemies, the hotter its mane
will grow.

name: Pyroar
description:
The females of a pride work together to bring
down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride
doesn't starve.

name: Oricorio
description:
This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up
blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

attacks.name: Inspiring Dance
attacks.effect: During your next turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Pop-Punk
attacks.effect: Discard 3 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Scorbunny
description:
Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet,
raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny's
footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Raboot
description:
While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves,
it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its
flames have heated up its forehead.

name: Cinderace
description:
Using a ball that it made out of flames,
Cinderace blinds its opponents and
keeps them at bay.

attacks.name: Fireball Shot
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

name: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon
description:
In this form, it draws on the power of fire.
It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.

attacks.name: Hearthflame Dance
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, take 2 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Alolan Vulpix
description:
In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards
with its six tails and sprays them around to cool
itself off.

attacks.name: Binding Snow
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't take any Energy from their Energy Zone to attach to their Active Pokémon.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
description:
It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its
feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a
frozen floor.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
description:
Its amusing movements make it very popular.
It releases its psychic power from the pattern
on its belly.

attacks.name: Triple Spin
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

name: Delibird
description:
It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes.
If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.

attacks.name: Box of Surprises
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon. If tails, heal 30 damage from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Mudkip
description:
When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed
rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its
small size.

name: Marshtomp
description:
It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers
poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents
that are bogged down and unable to move.

name: Swampert
description:
Swampert's arms are rock-hard. With one swing,
they can batter down Swampert's foes. This
Pokémon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

attacks.name: Large Whirlpool
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Strong-Armed Destroyer
attacks.effect: Discard 2 random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

name: Vanillite
description:
Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an
icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees
Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanillish
description:
It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148
degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it
spares their lives afterward—it's a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanilluxe
description:
People believe this Pokémon formed when two
Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is
roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Sweets Relay
attacks.effect: If 1 of your Pokémon used Sweets Relay during your last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Cryogonal
description:
Cryogonal uses its chains of ice to constrict its
opponents and then flash-freezes them where
they stand.

attacks.name: Frozen Lock
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

name: Amaura
description:
Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone
extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes
be found frozen in ice.

name: Aurorus
description:
When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate
freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

attacks.name: Hail Prison
attacks.effect: Discard Water2 {W} Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Chewtle
description:
A popular game among children is to lift up sticks
that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose
Chewtle can hang on the longest.

name: Drednaw
description:
Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey
come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck
out and chomps down on them.

name: Cramorant
description:
Cramorant takes advantage of Arrokuda's frantic
thrashing to help spit Arrokuda out at high speed.

attacks.name: Spit-Out Shot
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Arrokuda
description:
After it's eaten its fill, its movements become
extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant
swallows it up.

name: Barraskewda
description:
It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging
forward at speeds of over 100 knots before
ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon
description:
In this form, it draws on the power of water.
It attacks unrelentingly with kicks and ivy strikes.

attacks.name: Wellspring Dance
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack also does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Pikachu
description:
When several of these Pokémon gather, their
electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Alolan Raichu
description:
This Pokémon rides on its tail while it uses
its psychic powers to levitate. It attacks with
star-shaped thunderbolts.

abilities.name: Surge Surfer
abilities.effect: If a Stadium is in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Thunder Spear
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Zapdos
description:
Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It's said
that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together,
lightning will fall immediately after.

attacks.name: Heavy Thunder
attacks.effect: 1 other Pokémon (either yours or your opponent's) is chosen at random 1 time. Do 100 damage to the chosen Pokémon.

name: Plusle
description:
This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone
poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its
body to create noises.

attacks.name: Electric Tail
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Minun
description:
Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under
the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms
made of sparks for cheering.

attacks.name: Buddy Spark
attacks.effect: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Toxel
description:
This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores
poison and electricity in two different sacs inside
its body.

attacks.name: Damaging Spark
attacks.effect: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it.

name: Tadbulb
description:
It floats using the electricity stored in its body.
When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will
float higher off the ground.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.effect: Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

name: Bellibolt
description:
What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs
for discharging the electricity generated by
Bellibolt's belly-button dynamo.

name: Galarian Ponyta
description:
This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read
the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there,
it promptly hides away.

name: Galarian Rapidash
description:
Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily
through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic
power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

attacks.name: Photon Laser
attacks.effect: If you have 5 or more {P} Energy in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Wobbuffet
description:
To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly
in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

attacks.name: Flip Over
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Snubbull
description:
Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This
laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

name: Granbull
description:
It can make most any Pokémon run away
by opening its big mouth to reveal its
thick fangs.

name: Ralts
description:
It is highly attuned to the emotions of people
and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Kirlia
description:
The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy
for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances
when happy.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Gardevoir
description:
It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power
when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely
with.

attacks.name: Psy Turbo
attacks.effect: Take 2 {P} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched {P} Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fantasia Force
attacks.effect: Take 3 {P} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to your {P} Pokémon in any way you like.

name: Litwick
description:
While shining a light and pretending to be a
guide, it leeches off the life-force of any who
follow it.

name: Lampent
description:
The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs
around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
description:
It absorbs spirits, which it then burns. By waving
the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a
hypnotic trance.

attacks.name: Past Friends
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Supporter card in your discard pile.

name: Meloetta
description:
Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization
method that can control the feelings of those who
hear it.

abilities.name: Strange Singing
abilities.effect: At the beginning of your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put a random {P} Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

name: Pumpkaboo
description:
The light that streams out from the holes in the
pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people
and Pokémon that see it.

name: Gourgeist
description:
In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist
will come knocking. Whoever answers the door
will be swept off to the afterlife.

attacks.name: Soul Shot
attacks.effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Disguise
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon is first damaged by an attack after coming into play, prevent that damage.

name: Sinistea
description:
Sinistea gets into your body when you drink it,
and then it steals your vitality from within. It also
tastes awful.

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

name: Polteageist
description:
These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots
and pouring themselves into leftover tea.

abilities.name: Refreshing Tea
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may have your opponent shuffle their hand into their deck. For each remaining point that your opponent needs to win, they draw a card.

name: Indeedee
description:
This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer's side.
It predicts their actions with its psychic power
and takes care of their day-to-day needs.

attacks.name: Zen Shard
attacks.effect: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Sandshrew
description:
No matter how high a place it falls from, this
Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball
and bouncing.

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

name: Sandslash
description:
The spikes on its body are made up of its
hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes
with its spikes.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

name: Machop
description:
Always brimming with power, it passes time by
lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

attacks.name: Shatter
attacks.effect: Discard a Stadium in play.

name: Machoke
description:
Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps
people by doing work such as the moving of
heavy goods.

name: Machamp
description:
With four arms that react more quickly than it
can think, it can execute many punches at once.

attacks.name: Knocking Hammer
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

name: Cubone
description:
This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased
mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry,
but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

name: Meditite
description:
It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to
float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

name: Medicham
description:
It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like
steps, then launches a devastating blow in
the same motion.

attacks.name: Psykick
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has any {P} Energy attached, this attack does 50 more damage.

name: Roggenrola
description:
When it detects a noise, it starts to move.
The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon
slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
description:
It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its
vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever
changing the direction it's facing.

attacks.name: Megaton Cannon
attacks.effect: This attack does 140 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

name: Drilbur
description:
It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting
both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Tyrunt
description:
This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered.
It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer
just by playing around.

name: Tyrantrum
description:
A single bite of Tyrantrum's massive jaws will
demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the
ancient world.

attacks.name: Tyrannical Fang
attacks.effect: If you have fewer Pokémon in play than your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.

name: Passimian
description:
The boss chooses 10 members of the group to
go out hunting. The hunting party will evenly split
the food they find with the rest of the group.

attacks.name: Fling
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Falinks
description:
The leader, known as the brass, uses its
extendible horn to issue orders to the others
when it's time to change formation.

abilities.name: Coordinated Unit
abilities.effect: If you have another Falinks in play, this Pokémon's attacks do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon, and this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon
description:
In this form, it draws on the power of stone.
Its body is rock-solid, protecting it from all
manner of attacks.

attacks.name: Cornerstone Dance
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −100 damage from attacks.

name: Alolan Meowth
description:
Deeply proud and keenly smart, this Pokémon
moves with cunning during battle and relentlessly
attacks enemies' weak points.

attacks.name: Swagger
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Alolan Persian
description:
This Pokémon is one tough opponent. Not only
does it have formidable physical abilities, but it's
also not above fighting dirty.

name: Alolan Grimer
description:
Alolan Grimer will gladly gobble up any kind
of trash, making it a widely used and popular
Pokémon at garbage disposal facilities.

name: Alolan Muk
description:
What look like fangs and claws are actually
crystallized poison that will afflict you at a
mere touch, so don't get too close.

abilities.name: Power of Alchemy
abilities.effect: Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
description:
Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon,
it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon
its surroundings.

name: Galarian Linoone
description:
This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly
challenge opponents stronger than itself.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
description:
It evolved after experiencing numerous fights.
While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that
would make any opponent flinch.

attacks.name: Merciless Strike
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 50 more damage.

name: Stunky
description:
The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it
can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a
quarter away.

name: Skuntank
description:
It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its
tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

attacks.name: Smokescreen Shot
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

name: Spiritomb
description:
It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been
bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from
doing any mischief.

abilities.name: Final Scream
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Purrloin
description:
Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable
behavior come away with stinging scratches from
its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

attacks.name: Whiny Voice
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, look at a random card from your opponent's hand and shuffle it into their deck.

name: Liepard
description:
Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant
figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fasten Claws
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

name: Scraggy
description:
It will abruptly headbutt anyone that makes eye
contact with it. Its skull is extremely hard.

name: Scrafty
description:
This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very
good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

attacks.name: Crush the Weak
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has more Energy attached than your opponent's Active Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

name: Yveltal
description:
When its life comes to an end, it absorbs
the life energy of every living thing
and turns into a cocoon once more.

attacks.name: Evil Crash
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from both Active Pokémon.

name: Guzzlord
description:
An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be
constantly hungry—it is certainly always
devouring something.

attacks.name: Breakcore
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Galarian Meowth
description:
These daring Pokémon have coins on their
foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder
coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker
description:
After many battles, it evolved dangerous
claws that come together to form daggers
when extended.

abilities.name: Dig Up
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may put 2 random Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Mawile
description:
It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are
actually steel horns that have been transformed.

attacks.name: Heat-Up Crunch
attacks.effect: Until this Pokémon leaves the Active Spot, this Pokémon's Heat-Up Crunch attack does +30 damage. This effect stacks.

name: Excadrill
description:
Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong
enough to bore through iron plates. This
Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

name: Ferroseed
description:
Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings.
Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed's
spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn
description:
Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon
crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes
on its feelers into the stone.

attacks.name: Pummel
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
description:
Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in
the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps
its jagged steel fins down on them.

attacks.name: Snapping Trap
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot when your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, this attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

name: Honedge
description:
The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the
true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it
drains people's lives away.

name: Doublade
description:
The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly
alternating between offense and defense to
bring down their prey.

attacks.name: Dual Blades
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

name: Aegislash
description:
Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate
others. It once used its powers to force people
and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

attacks.name: Superb Shield
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −80 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex.

name: Bagon
description:
Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is
apparently the influence of information carried
in its genes.

name: Shelgon
description:
Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off.
The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy
and somewhat sluggish.

name: Salamence
description:
It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged.
It destroys everything with shredding claws
and fire.

attacks.name: Dragon Dive
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

name: Meowth
description:
It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny
object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

abilities.name: Carefree Steps
abilities.effect: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Feelin' Fine
attacks.effect: Draw a card.

name: Persian
description:
It has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises
its tail straight up. This is a signal that it is about
to pounce and bite.

name: Kangaskhan
description:
There are records of a lost human child being
raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

attacks.name: Steady Punch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Double-Punching Family
attacks.effect:
This attack is used twice in a row. The second attack does 40 damage.
(If the first attack Knocks Out your opponent's Active Pokémon, the second attack is used after your opponent chooses a new Active Pokémon.)

name: Sentret
description:
If it encounters a foe, it will stand up on its tail,
making itself look bigger than usual to intimidate
them.

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

name: Furret
description:
It is nimble and has a very flexible body.
Even if you get ahold of it, it'll slip right out
of your arms.

name: Smeargle
description:
The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from
the tip of the tail is predetermined for each
Smeargle.

abilities.name: Portrait
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at a random Supporter card from your opponent's hand. Use the effect of that card as the effect of this Ability.

name: Lugia
description:
It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is
rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

attacks.name: Aeroblast
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

name: Taillow
description:
It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other
lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles
a day.

name: Swellow
description:
It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its
prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

abilities.name: Repelling Wind
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may switch out your opponent's Active Basic Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

name: Slakoth
description:
The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who
watches it feel like doing the same.

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

name: Vigoroth
description:
It is always hungry because it won't stop
rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can't
keep still.

attacks.name: Best Punch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

name: Slaking
description:
This Pokémon lives lying on its side. It only
rolls over and moves when there is no more
grass to eat.

abilities.name: Snoozing Habit
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever you attach an Energy from your Energy Zone to it, it is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Knuckle Sandwich
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Spinda
description:
Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its
stumbling movements, it evades opponents'
attacks brilliantly!

attacks.name: Teetering Steps
attacks.effect: This Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Tornadus
description:
Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail,
causing severe storms. Its power is great enough
to blow houses away.

attacks.name: Blow Through
attacks.effect: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 40 more damage.

name: Bunnelby
description:
It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of
Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby
digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Diggersby
description:
The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally
well. People used to make heavy winter clothing
from fur shed by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Furfrou
description:
Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer,
but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

abilities.name: Fur Coat
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

name: Tandemaus
description:
The pair sticks together no matter what. They
split any food they find exactly in half and then
eat it together.

attacks.name: Flock
attacks.effect: Put 3 random cards from among Tandemaus and Maushold from your deck onto your Bench.

name: Maushold
description:
The larger pair protects the little ones during
battles. When facing strong opponents, the
whole group will join the fight.

attacks.name: Family Beatdown
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each Tandemaus and Maushold you have in play. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

name: Jaw Fossil
effect:
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic {C} Pokémon.
At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
This card can't retreat.

name: Lucky Ice Pop
effect: Heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon. If you healed any damage in this way, flip a coin. If heads, put this Lucky Ice Pop into your hand instead of the discard pile.

name: Sail Fossil
effect:
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic {C} Pokémon.
At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.
This card can't retreat.

name: Protective Poncho
effect: As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to that Pokémon by your opponent's attacks and Abilities.

name: Metal Core Barrier
effect:
If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your opponent's turn.

The {M} Pokémon this card is attached to takes −50 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Diantha
effect: Heal 90 damage from 1 of your {P} Pokémon that has 2 or more {P} Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard 2 {P} Energy from that Pokémon.

name: Sightseer
effect: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put all Stage 1 Pokémon you find there into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

name: Juggler
effect:
You can use this card only if your Pokémon in play have 3 or more different types of Energy attached.

Move all Energy from each of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

name: Piers
effect:
You can use this card only if you have Galarian Obstagoon in play.

Discard 2 random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Training Area
effect: Attacks used by Stage 1 Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) do +10 damage to the opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Starting Plains
effect: Each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +20 HP.

name: Peculiar Plaza
effect: The Retreat Cost of each {P} Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is 2 less.

name: Cacnea
description:
It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom
once a year.

name: Roserade
description:
The poison in its right hand is quick acting.
The poison in its left hand is slow acting.
Both are life threatening.

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

name: Vivillon
description:
This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers
bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its
wings during battle.

attacks.name: Vivid Powder
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Asleep.

name: Buzzwole
description:
Buzzwole goes around showing off its
abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind
of Ultra Beast.

attacks.name: Ground Beat
attacks.effect: If your opponent has gotten exactly 1 points, this attack does 40 more damage.

name: Reshiram
description:
When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves
the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

attacks.name: Blue Flare
attacks.effect: Discard 2 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Oricorio
description:
This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up
blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

attacks.name: Inspiring Dance
attacks.effect: During your next turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Scorbunny
description:
Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet,
raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny's
footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Aurorus
description:
When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate
freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

thrashing to help spit Arrokuda out at high speed.

the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms
made of sparks for cheering.

This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores

its body.

This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read
the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there,
it promptly hides away.

name: Snubbull

Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This
laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer's side.
It predicts their actions with its psychic power
and takes care of their day-to-day needs.

No matter how high a place it falls from, this
Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball
and bouncing.

A single bite of Tyrantrum's massive jaws will
demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the
ancient world.

The leader, known as the brass, uses its
extendible horn to issue orders to the others
when it's time to change formation.

description:
What look like fangs and claws are actually
crystallized poison that will afflict you at a
mere touch, so don't get too close.

Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable
behavior come away with stinging scratches from
its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Yveltal

When its life comes to an end, it absorbs
the life energy of every living thing
and turns into a cocoon once more.

It evolved after experiencing numerous fights.
While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that
would make any opponent flinch.

After many battles, it evolved dangerous
claws that come together to form daggers
when extended.

It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged.
It destroys everything with shredding claws
and fire.

The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who
watches it feel like doing the same.

description:
It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny
object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

abilities.effect: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Feelin' Fine
attacks.effect: Draw a card.

name: Tangela
description:
Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows
nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this
Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

name: Magby
description:
This Pokémon is still small and timid.
Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised,
flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

attacks.name: Toasty Toss
attacks.effect: Take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

name: Magmar
description:
Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it
regrets this habit once it realizes that it has
burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.effect: Take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

name: Horsea
description:
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle
currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits
out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra
description:
It's the males that raise the offspring. While
Seadra are raising young, the spines on their
backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

name: Mantyke
description:
It's highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that
take people swimming with Mantyke are a
super-popular beach activity.

attacks.name: Splashy Toss
attacks.effect: Take a {W} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

name: Omanyte
description:
Because some Omanyte manage to escape after
being restored or are released into the wild by
people, this species is becoming a problem.

name: Omastar
description:
Weighed down by a large and heavy shell,
Omastar couldn't move very fast. Some say it
went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

attacks.name: Ancient Whirlpool
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

name: Pichu
description:
It is unskilled at storing electric power.
Any kind of shock causes it to discharge
energy spontaneously.

attacks.name: Crackly Toss
attacks.effect: Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

name: Clefairy
description:
It is said that happiness will come to those who
see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a
full moon.

name: Clefable
description:
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will
run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Latias
description:
It communicates using telepathy. Its body is
covered in down that refracts light to make
it invisible.

attacks.name: Crossing Flights
attacks.effect: If Latios is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage.

name: Latios
description:
It understands human speech and is highly
intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that
dislikes fighting.

abilities.name: Fantastical Floating
abilities.effect: If you have Latias in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Luster Purge
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Hitmonlee
description:
This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of
balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

attacks.name: Stretch Kick
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Hitmonchan
description:
Its punches slice the air. They are launched at
such high speed, even a slight graze could cause
a burn.

name: Kabuto
description:
This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto
molt every three days, making their shells harder
and harder.

name: Kabutops
description:
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out
the fluids. The discarded body parts become
food for other Pokémon.

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.effect: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Phanpy
description:
This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank.
After playing in the mud, it won't be able to
settle down unless it washes its body.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Tyrogue
description:
It is always bursting with energy. To make itself
stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Tauros
description:
When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails,
it's a warning that the Pokémon is about to
charge with astounding speed.

Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization
method that can control the feelings of those who
hear it.

name: Ivysaur

name: Venusaur

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

description: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

name: Caterpie

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.effect: Put 1 random {G} Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

description: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Metapod
description: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

name: Butterfree

abilities.name: Powder Heal
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

description: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Weedle
description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Beedrill
description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

name: Oddish
description: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
description: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Vileplume

attacks.name: Soothing Scent
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

description: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Paras
description: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Parasect
description: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

name: Venonat
description: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

name: Venomoth

attacks.name: Poison Powder
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Bellsprout
description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel

abilities.name: Fragrance Trap

description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Exeggcute
description: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

description: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Tangela

name: Scyther

name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Double Horn
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

description: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Cottonee
description: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Whimsicott
description: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

name: Petilil

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

description: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Leaf Supply
attacks.effect: Take a {G} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched {G} Pokémon.

description: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

name: Skiddo

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

description: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the backs of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

name: Gogoat
description: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

name: Charmander

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.effect: Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

description: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
description: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

name: Charizard

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.effect: Discard 2 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

description: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

attacks.name: Crimson Storm
attacks.effect: Discard 2 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.effect: Discard 1 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

description: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Growlithe
description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Heat Tackle

description: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

attacks.name: Inferno Onrush
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

name: Ponyta
description: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

name: Rapidash
description: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Magmar
description: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Flareon

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.effect: Discard 1 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

description: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Moltres

attacks.name: Sky Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

description: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

attacks.name: Inferno Dance
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. Take an amount of {R} Energy from your Energy Zone equal to the number of heads and attach it to your Benched {R} Pokémon in any way you like.

name: Heatmor
description: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Salandit
description: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
description: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Sizzlipede
description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.effect: Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Squirtle
description: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
description: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Blastoise

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

attacks.name: Hydro Bazooka
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Headache
attacks.effect: Your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.

description: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
description: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Poliwag
description: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
description: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Poliwrath

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

description: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

name: Tentacool
description: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.

name: Tentacruel

attacks.name: Poison Tentacles
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

description: When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

name: Seel
description: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Dewgong
description: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

name: Shellder
description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attacks.

description: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Krabby
description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

name: Kingler

attacks.name: KO Crab
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 80 more damage.

description: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Horsea
description: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Seaking

attacks.name: Horn Hazard
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

description: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

name: Staryu
description: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Starmie
description: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Magikarp
description: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Lapras

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.

description: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Vaporeon

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

description: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
